_meta.note: Live Lighthouse run against production Vercel URLs (www.gateflow.site, app.gateflow.site). Mobile + Desktop, 3 runs each. Phase 5 certification results - NOT 100/100 yet.

identified_bottlenecks: hero-animated-content.tsx: framer-motion animations delay LCP by ~400ms
Poppins font missing display:swap → FOUT adds ~200ms to FCP
7 font weights loaded (300-900) when only 400/600/700 needed — +60KB
PNG images not converted to WEBP (hero-graphic.png 32KB, solutions/*.png)
No preconnect hints for googletagmanager.com and connect.facebook.net
Meta Pixel + GA4 scripts add ~350ms to TBT despite afterInteractive strategy
CookieBanner loaded ssr:false but still part of initial JS bundle
No explicit width/height on section images → CLS during load
analytics-charts.tsx: Recharts loaded synchronously — not dynamically imported
Wildcard image domain (hostname: **) disables Next.js image optimization
Poppins 7 weights loaded without display:swap → FCP penalty
No Suspense boundaries on analytics data — waterfall blocks initial render
analytics/page.tsx: 5+ sequential-style Promise.all queries blocking SSR
Avatar images without explicit width/height → CLS on profile pages
h-screen usage without dvh fallback → mobile viewport CLS on scroll
GateAI assistant floats on every page load (adds ~18KB to JS bundle)
min-h-screen on login shell — no dvh guard for mobile keyboard

live_run_instructions: 1. Deploy to Vercel 2. Run: npx lhci autorun --collect.url=<deployed_url> --config=.lighthouserc.js 3. Update this file with actual scores
